meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 收到文章、笔记或主题后，Claude会把它制作成一段“无脸解说视频”：不拍实景，而是为每个场景设计排版、图表等虚拟画面，并产出分镜、脚本和最终视频文件。
howto.when: 当你说“把这段文字做成解说视频”，或要求做主题解说、概念分解、操作指南等时触发；若涉及网站实拍或产品宣传，则不会使用。

say.text: 把这篇关于光合作用的文章做成无脸解说视频。
say.note: 它会初始化项目并开始制作流程。

say.text: 解释一下区块链概念，用无脸视频风格，带图表。
say.note: 它会选择设计预设，生成分镜和脚本。

say.text: 把这个操作步骤列表变成1分钟解说视频。
say.note: 它会规划每帧画面，并生成配音和最终视频。

howto.what_en: Turns text into a faceless explainer video. No capture; visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Outputs: storyboard, script, audio, frames, final render.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to turn text into a faceless explainer video (topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles). Not for website-based videos; unclear cases go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about photosynthesis into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It will initialize the project and start the pipeline.

say_en.text: Explain blockchain with a faceless style and include diagrams.
say_en.note: It will pick a preset and generate storyboard and script.

say_en.text: Make a 1-minute explainer from this list of steps.
say_en.note: It will plan frames, generate voiceover and final video.
